_comment: P feature ablation (docs/FEATURE_FAMILIES.md): policy family p2 against p3 at the same capacity (the XXL preset), the same layout-3 shards rebuilt from the same raw matches as the committed models, the same configuration and seed. Offline first (training.compare_policy, stratified by contact, pursuit, retreat, carrier states, distance and team count), then at equal full-turn time with V off (bots/p_only/profiles/screen_p_features.json). Nothing else changes: target head, candidate limit, adapter, search depth and mixture stay as they are.

shards.options: the committed models' dataset options (index.json of data/shards)

audit: training.feature_audit on the layout-3 train split (candidate coverage, value aliases) before any limit changes
